channel.title: Houston Public Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Houston Public Media (houstonpublicmedia.org)

item.title: Hello Houston (March 23, 2026) | Houston Public Media
item.description: Today: We talk with Rice University President Reginald DesRoches, meteorologist Justin Ballard breaks down the El Niño weather event, comedian Marcus D. Wiley tells us about his new comedy special, and more.

item.title: Hello Houston – The Commuter Cut (March 23, 2026) | Houston Public Media
item.description: For our busy Houston commuters, we have – The Commuter Cut – a special 40-minute version of our show to listen to during your journey home.

item.title: Meteors are more common than you might think. Here’s what happened with one in Houston | Houston Public Media
item.description: A 3-foot-wide meteor weighing about a ton broke through the Earth’s atmosphere on Saturday and exploded with the force of 26 tons of TNT. A piece of the space rock crashed into a home.

item.title: Protestors march in downtown Houston to oppose CERAWeek on first day of 2026 energy conference | Houston Public Media
item.description: CERAWeek by S&P Global is an annual gathering of energy executives and government representatives at the George R. Brown Convention Center.

item.title: TotalEnergies starts CERAWeek by saying it will end offshore wind projects, reinvest in oil and gas | Houston Public Media
item.description: The French company, with a U.S. headquarters in Houston, made the announcement on the first day of the global energy conference being held this week at the George R. Brown Convention Center.

item.title: Cody Johnson sets concert attendance record to conclude 2026 Houston rodeo | Houston Public Media
item.description: A total of 2.6 million people attended the Houston rodeo this year held across three weeks at NRG Park.

item.title: State of the energy industry (March 24, 2026) | Houston Public Media
item.description: On Tuesday's show: We learn about events, speakers, and protests happening during the annual CERAWeek energy conference this week in Houston and we dig into the state of the energy industry amid ever-rising oil prices.

item.title: Fire out and shelter-in-place order is lifted after oil refinery explosion in Port Arthur | Houston Public Media
item.description: No one was injured in Monday's explosion at a Valero refinery near the Texas coast, Port Arthur Mayor Charlotte M. Moses said.

item.title: Texas Education Agency orders public schools to remove mentions of César Chávez from lessons | Houston Public Media
item.description: Schools were also directed to cancel or change celebrations of the late civil rights leader amid allegations of sexual abuse.

item.title: Hourslong security lines at Bush Airport leave Houston travelers missing flights, rebooking while they wait | Houston Public Media
item.description: The Trump administration sent ICE agents to airports in Houston and across the U.S. on Monday to assist TSA workers, many of whom are calling out sick amid a partial government shutdown that began in mid-February.
